pages.title: Heat Exchangers
pages.text: A heat exchanger moves heat between two fluid loops that never touch each other.$(br2)One loop runs through the $(thing)Condenser$() channel and gives up heat. The other runs through the $(thing)Evaporator$() channel and takes it. Nothing is generated here; heat is only moved.

pages.title: What it is for
pages.text: The usual job is condensing turbine exhaust back into water so it can return to the reactor without a fresh supply.$(br2)The other job is running a two stage setup: a reactor boils a high temperature fluid, the exchanger uses that to boil steam, and the steam drives the turbine.

pages.title: Size
pages.text: The smallest heat exchanger is $(thing)4 x 3 x 3$(). With the default config the largest is $(thing)64 x 96 x 64$().$(br2)Throughput comes from how much channel you can fit inside, so a long thin exchanger works as well as a cube.
